Which of the numbers(not digits) should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

216 ÷ 9 × 16 + 24 - 27 = 126

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(17, 153, 81)

(19, 171, 81)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First number** **× 9 = Second number and 81 is the third number.

 
• (17, 153, 81) → 17 × 9 = 153 and 81 is the third number.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Smell : Nose :: Colours : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **Second is used to perceive the first one.

 
• Smell : Nose → We smell by nose.

Similarly,

 
• Colours : ? → We see colours by eyes.

Hence, '**Eyes**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II & III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some doctors are tigers.

All tigers are umbrellas.

Some umbrellas are buses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some doctors are umbrellas.

II. Some tigers are umbrellas.

III. Some buses are umbrellas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58da579dd09a905a08a7fa55f08d73622c6e8f290af7281be9aec715f50c412a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some doctors are umbrellas. → **Follows** (As, Some doctors are tigers and All tigers are umbrellas)

II. Some tigers are umbrellas. → Follows (As, All tigers are umbrellas)

III. Some buses are umbrellas. → Follows (As, Some umbrellas are buses)

Hence, '**All conclusions follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people S, F, A, G, D, H, and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of G. F is third to the right of A. S is the immediate neighbour to D and A. G is the immediate neighbour to F and H. Who sits at the extreme right of the row?
questions.solution:
Seven people **S, F, A, G, D, H, and T** are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1. Only two people sit to the right of G.

2. G is the immediate neighbour to F and H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea6c38773963c8fd86ec34bfb8a8122f9145fc40911d91a9f34ba55abe78898f.png] 

3. F is third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9046c3dd16fe4fb13347426ae236f05bef93dcb30c6e59c678a5b257944ba2e9.png] 

4. S is the immediate neighbour to D and A.

The above condition cannot be satisfies in Case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b249a19883bc16ae565a67e64c62b088423551b7aaa4f2562071fcafb40c6700.png] 

Clearly, T the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eede55bac6e75b66bee94f4cc1a1c5e73a9dde24d125a044643396e5face8845.png] 

Clearly, T sits at the extreme right of the row.

Hence, '**T**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

8 + 32 ÷ 16 × 11 - 5 = 22

Preethi arranges different colours of teddy bears in her bedroom in two parallel rows facing each other such that four teddies are in each row. Orange, Yellow, Grey and Brown teddies are in Row 1 facing north, while Red, White, Black and Pink teddies are in Row 2 facing south. Orange teddy is adjacent to the Grey teddy. Pink teddy does not face the Orange one. White teddy faces the one that is second to the right of the Grey teddy. The Black one is second to the right of the Pink teddy. The Brown teddy is not at any of the corners. The Orange teddy is not at any of the extreme ends. The Grey teddy faces the Red one. How many teddies are there between Red and White teddies?
questions.solution:
Preethi arranges different colours of teddy bears in her bedroom in two parallel rows facing each other such that four teddies are in each row. Orange, Yellow, Grey and Brown teddies are in Row 1 facing north, while Red, White, Black and Pink teddies are in Row 2 facing south.

**South:** Red, White, Black and Pink

**North:** Orange, Yellow, Grey and Brown

1. Orange teddy is adjacent to the Grey teddy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6980339323785b86d6137c58ae370abb4a9ce777e7761230a8e4dc453fa4f33.png] 

 

2. The Grey teddy faces the Red one.

3. Pink teddy does not face the Orange one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/034f42326da8bc746494df1dbfc75ef43a298afa03c2bd98a87f45e852b54d7c.png] 

4. White teddy faces the one that is second to the right of the Grey teddy. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4b8e53dcf5860b9dce6070add983270397144a423d2565cc2360c50c2e0f1f4.png] 

5. The Orange teddy is not at any of the extreme ends. 

Based on the above statement, Case II is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b407e8d474b2bf894be805de79a938fe844f58344985fb91dd8ef4acdcffa65d.png] 

6. The Black one is second to the right of the Pink teddy.

7. The Brown teddy is not at any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a98a0a85582f8a8a5e8b3cb185156c57c240a7bf5837af69ffd0f1afd607ca70.png] 

Yellow, the only Teddy left, will occupy the only possible position for him in the arrangement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4c2a228d78e1c41093714c96a7b35095cd96587ead8c3e9f24122de58fb52d.png] 

Clearly, there is only one teddy in between Red and White teddy.

Hence, '**one**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:

‘X # Y’ means ‘X is the daughter of Y’

‘X * Y’ means ‘X is the father of Y’

‘X $ Y’ means ‘X is the wife of Y’

If ‘A $ B – D * C’, then how is A related to D?

options.text: A is the sister-in-law of D
A is the sister of D
A is the daughter of D
A is the son of D

questions.solution:
X is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
*

 
 
 
$

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
wife

 
 
 

 
 
to Y

 
 
 

A $ B – D * C → A is wife of B, B is brother of D, D is father of C.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png]

Hence, ‘**A is the sister-in-law of D**’ is the correct answer.
